title: 第九章 快来百盛园餐厅第十章 请你到一边去吧
content_zh:
白染还想说什么，不过这个时候，她的手机突然就响了。
“喂，啊，表姐啊……这个，我也只能表示同情啊……以你的条件……老一辈都那样子嘛，也别太往心里去……”
说了一会儿，白染就挂了电话。
“社长，是谁啊？”一个男生笑嘻嘻的凑过来问道。
“我表姐。”白染打开一瓶饮料喝起来。
“啊，你表姐，是不是上次那个开着白色福特，来找你的那个长腿美女，挺有气质的那个？”
“嗯啊。”
“什么事啊？”这男生还挺八卦的。
白染瞟了他一眼，似乎也在说你这男生怎么回事跟个女人似的，不过还是说道，“没啥，就是我姐她年龄也不小了，家里都希望她早点找对象，可她一直单着，这不，我姨夫和我姨又开始催她了，她打电话找我诉苦呢。我也只能安慰安慰啊。”
“嘿嘿，真的？那你看看我，介绍给你表姐呗。”男生说道。
“就你？”
白染哼了一声，“我表姐条件不错，眼光也高着呢，就你这模样，你爸只不过是一个公司的部门经理，我姐肯定看不上你啊。”
“唉，你表姐要是再这么眼光高下去，将来只有找陆原这样的了。”男生酸溜溜的说道。
“滚，想死是吧！”
白染秀眉一挑，男生吓得赶紧跑了。
只是陆原躺着也中枪，实在是，呵呵。
“我表姐打死也不会看上这种吊丝的。”白染摇摇头，伸了个拦腰，“好无聊啊，风聆，我们去哪玩啊。”
话刚说完，风聆还没来得及回答呢。
一辆黑色的奥迪A4L，刷的从拐弯处开了过来，停在网球场门口。
车上下来一个穿着条纹衬衫的男生，还戴着个墨镜，粉色西裤，看起来很骚气。

“孙监，你买车啦！”
白染立即飞也似的跑了过去。
其他网球社的人，也都围了上去。
“孙社长不愧是我们网球社第一富少啊，都开上车了，还是奥迪，霸气啊。”
“这车得五六十万吧。”一个女生赞叹得说道。
“哪用得着啊，这是低配的，三十多万而已，我就是刚拿到驾照，拿来练练手，开两年就卖了。”孙监这一招欲扬先抑的装逼，玩的也挺溜的。
果然，又是惹得众人一阵恭维。
“他是谁啊？”只有风聆和陆原没有围过去，他们还坐在原来的地方。
看到孙监这么受欢迎，风聆问道。
“他叫孙监，是副社长，家里挺有钱的。”陆原说道。
这孙监，陆原自然也知道，确实比较有钱，还是学生就开上奥迪A4，也绝非普通的富裕家庭了。
“正愁着没地方玩呢，孙监，开车带我们溜溜风呗！”白染抛了个媚眼，说道。
“行啊。”
能不行吗，孙监的目的就是开车来泡白染的。
对白染，孙监早就觊觎已久了。
只不过他也知道，白染虽然拜金，但是眼光也够高的，不是随随便便就能泡到的。
所以他加入网球社，细水长流。
不断的接近白染，做到了副社长的位置，和白染关系更亲近了不少。
不过，始终没有和白染擦出火花，产生质变。
所以，孙监这一次，下了血本，让家里给买了这辆奥迪，就是展示下资本，好把白染泡到手的。

“风聆，走，咱们去兜风了！”
content_en:
Bai Ran wanted to say something else, but at this moment, her cell phone suddenly rang.
"Hey, ah, cousin... I can only sympathize with this... Based on your conditions... the older generation is like that, so don't take it too seriously..."
After talking for a while, Bai Ran hung up the phone.
"President, who is it?" A boy came over and asked with a smile.
"My cousin." Bai Ran opened a bottle of drink and drank.
"Ah, your cousin, is she the long-legged beauty who drove the white Ford and came to see you last time? The pretty one?"
"Yeah."
"What's going on?" This boy is quite gossipy.
Bai Ran glanced at him and seemed to be wondering why you, a boy, act like a woman, but he still said, "It's okay. Even my sister is not young anymore. The family hopes that she will find a partner soon, but she has been single. No, my uncle and my aunt started to push her again. She called me to complain. I can only comfort her."
"Hey, really? Then look at me and introduce me to your cousin." The boy said.
"Just you?"
Bai Ran snorted, "My cousin is in good condition and has high standards. With your appearance, your father is just a department manager of a company. My sister will definitely look down on you."
"Well, if your cousin continues to have such high standards, she will only have people like Lu Yuan in the future." The boy said sourly.
"Go away, you want to die, don't you?"
Bai Ran raised his eyebrows, and the boy was so frightened that he ran away.
It’s just that Lu Yuan was shot while lying down, it’s really, haha.
"My cousin will never fall in love with this kind of hanging thread." Bai Ran shook his head and stretched his waist, "It's so boring, Feng Ling, where should we go to play."
As soon as he finished speaking, Feng Ling didn't have time to answer.
A black Audi A4L came around the corner and stopped at the entrance of the tennis court.
A boy got out of the car wearing a striped shirt, sunglasses, and pink trousers. He looked very coquettish.
"Supervisor Sun, you bought a car!"
Bairan immediately ran over like flying.
People from other tennis clubs also gathered around.
"President Sun is indeed the richest young man in our tennis club. He even drives a car, and it's an Audi. He's so domineering."
"This car costs five to six hundred thousand," a girl said in admiration.
"There's no need for it. This is a low-end model. It only costs more than 300,000 yuan. I just got my driver's license and used it to practice my skills. I drove it for two years and sold it." Supervisor Sun was very good at pretending to be aggressive but restrained.
Sure enough, it provoked a burst of compliments from everyone.
"Who is he?" Only Feng Ling and Lu Yuan did not come around, they were still sitting in the same place.
Seeing that Supervisor Sun was so popular, Feng Ling asked.
"His name is Sun Jian, he is the vice president, and his family is quite wealthy." Lu Yuan said.
Of course Lu Yuan also knew that Supervisor Sun was indeed relatively wealthy. He drove an Audi A4 when he was still a student. He was definitely not from an ordinary wealthy family.
"I'm worried that I don't have anywhere to play. Supervisor Sun, please take us for a ride!" Bai Ran said with a wink.
"Okay."
Is it possible? Sun Jian’s purpose is to drive here to pick up Bai Ran.
Supervisor Sun has been coveting Bai Ran for a long time.
But he also knew that although Bai Ran worshiped money, his vision was high enough, and he couldn't get it just casually.
So he joined the tennis club and prospered.
He kept getting close to Bai Ran and reached the position of vice president, and his relationship with Bai Ran became much closer.
However, there was never any sparks with Bai Ran that caused a qualitative change.
Therefore, this time, Supervisor Sun spent a lot of money to buy this Audi for his family, just to show off his capital so that he could get Bai Ran.
"Feng Ling, let's go for a ride!"
